aggregation: arithmetic mean over the 32 batches of per-update byte-weighted BPB (token NLL summed over each 128-example update, divided by its continuation bytes and ln 2), reported both as gap_bpb = transferred minus canonical BPB (the regret of the step-6,500 ranking) and as raw_bpb = transferred BPB (this run's training reward)

confirmation.interpretation: Discovery winner has higher regret on confirmation batches.
Discovery winner has higher raw BPB on confirmation batches.

raw_bpb_and_reference.note: comparisons holds compare_policy() output on mean raw BPB, so its *_gap fields are raw BPB; the top-level comparisons and confirmation are on gap_bpb, which they call regret
